description: Defines the interface for the upper PHY layer in a radio system, including classes, methods, and notifiers related to uplink and downlink processing, error handling, and metrics collection.

classes.name: upper_phy
classes.description: Interface describing the upper PHY layer with methods for accessing controllers, handlers, notifiers, and processing pools.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns the operation controller of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_rx_symbol_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the receive symbol handler of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_timing_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the timing handler of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_error_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the error handler of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_downlink_processor_pool
methods.description: Returns the downlink processor pool of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_downlink_resource_grid_pool
methods.description: Returns the downlink resource grid pool of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_uplink_request_processor
methods.description: Returns the uplink request processor of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_uplink_pdu_slot_repository
methods.description: Returns the uplink slot PDU repository of this upper PHY.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector of this upper PHY or nullptr if metrics are not enabled.

methods.name: set_timing_notifier
methods.description: Sets the upper PHY timing notifier.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the upper PHY, waiting for pending tasks to finish.
